executor_config.executor: local mode - the driver JVM is also the executor

optimisation.method: Task 2 settings as 'before'; one change at a time; before/after runs alternate; median wall time; every run is a named Spark job group; stage metrics read from the Spark UI REST API

changes.Rationale: 6 of 8 metric jobs re-read 433,788 rows and re-ran the pipeline + GBTRegressor (Table 3.1b); cache holds 4.8 MB vs 85.6 MB for all columns
changes.Stage: test scan + score, repeated in 6 jobs

changes.Rationale: 11 uneven partitions for 12 cores: longest task 1.15x the median on every pass; balanced tasks, 2 per core
changes.Stage: GBTRegressor retrain, 16 data passes of 11 -> 24 tasks

changes.Rationale: 138 short jobs left cores idle (47.6% busy); 2 fits at a time -> 64.9% busy; 4 checked: 71.6 s
changes.Stage: CrossValidator.fit, LR 4 x 3 folds on 255,855 rows

stability.method: test inputs perturbed (hash-based noise, identical rows for every model); models not retrained; delta = perturbed - clean on all test rows; rank 1 = smallest delta RMSE

explainability.method: SHAP: exact path-dependent TreeSHAP computed from the saved Spark trees (toDebugString); node covers from a 2% training sample; state one-hots grouped
explainability.named_bias_risk: Extreme-weather and regional bias: on test days >= 35 deg C the forecast is +1.9 deg C too cold and on days <= -10 deg C 5.4 deg C too warm; state RMSE ranges from 2.49 (Florida) to 5.04 deg C (South Dakota), following weather swing (rank corr. +0.73) more than station count (+0.17)
